newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 23.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Finance and Justice ministries want stocks held by companies to reflect current market values in company books.
-- Government advisory bodies on legislation headed for extinction under Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's reform plan.
-- Police obtain arrest warrant for a 25-year-old man over missing junior high school girl in Nara Prefecture, western Japan.
-- North Korea agrees to allow Japanese wives of North Korean men to make visits to Japan.
-- Ruling alliance panel eyes standard medical charges for treatment of chronic diseases.
